name: Scheme For Adolescent Girls
benefit:
> **Nutritional Benefits:**

1. The applicant receives supplementary nutrition containing 600 calories, 18-20 grams of protein and micronutrients.
1. The supplementary nutrition is provided in the form of Take Home Ration (THR).
1. The benefit is provided for 300 days in a year.
1. The Take Home Ration is prepared with fortified micronutrients as per nutritional standards.
1. Age-specific processe
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be an adolescent girl in the age group of 14-18 years. 1. The applicant should be identified by the concerned State Government. 1. The applicant should belong to the covered areas under the scheme, including Aspirational Districts of States, including Assam and North-Eastern States. 1. The applicant should have an Aadhaar number to avail benefits under the scheme.
